Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Mon ami, we are both too young to die ! Mon écorce is hard enough that I would split in half if I was to fall.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: What is there to do, anyway ? Le Trork sells same things all day because not many Kweebecs have use for l'or, and notre marchands sell anything that ...

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: One of his hands pans across the canopy.

Line.Text: ... you can see from here and pick up yourself.
